latest.title: Five scene findings flag kids needing blood
latest.finding: All five predictors independently predicted blood within 4 h of ED arrival; low/intermediate/high CART tiers had 1.2%/6.1%/36.7% transfusion rates, and the high-risk tier captured 36.8% of all early transfusions

latest.title: Decreasing response phase lights and siren use through modification
latest.finding: L&S response fell from 98% to 12% of calls and total response-phase L&S hours from 172 to 24 per month (−86%); 4 post-change calls (0.2%) needed L&S transport, only 1 requiring advanced interventions

latest.title: Why patients decline hypoglycaemia call-back programs
latest.finding: Non-participation reasons: time constraints 56%, perceived lack of benefit 25%, privacy concerns or discomfort with home visits 25%
